description: A large, structured red leather handbag with a glossy finish and a curved, slouchy silhouette. The bag features a top zip closure, a short top handle, and contrasting red leather trim along the edges. The rich red color and smooth leather texture create a bold, statement-making piece.

A structured, upright trapezoidal bag with a glossy gold metallic finish and a prominent, ornate dragonfly-shaped clasp at the front flap. The body features a horizontal green-red-green Web stripe across the center, and is carried by a chain strap with a beaded handle. The material appears to be textured leather with a metallic sheen, and the hardware is gold-toned.

A structured top handle bag with a beige leather body accented by bold red and green horizontal stripes. It features distinctive bamboo handles, a gold-tone horsebit hardware closure, and a matching adjustable shoulder strap with green and red webbing. The design incorporates a star-shaped leather patch on the front flap, embodying a classic equestrian-inspired aesthetic.

A structured silver crocodile-effect leather handbag featuring a distinctive bamboo handle and matching bamboo hardware. The bag has a flap closure secured by a central bamboo clasp and is adorned with a black leather tassel. A chain strap with silver-toned metal links provides additional carrying options.

A large tote bag with a two-tone design featuring a brown suede body and a contrasting orange leather panel along the top edge. The front is adorned with a large, embroidered GG logo in orange thread, while the sides display colorful, appliquéd musical note motifs in pink, green, and blue. The bag has a structured, rectangular silhouette with a top zip closure and is carried by a wide, orange leather shoulder strap.

A white leather top handle bag with a distinctive curved flap closure and bamboo handle detailing. The bag features a textured leather body with contrasting black trim and a prominent bamboo hardware clasp at the center of the flap. The handles are crafted from polished bamboo with gold-tone metal fittings.

A striking red leather top handle bag featuring a bold white snakeskin panel at the center, adorned with a metallic fox head clasp and intricate insect embroidery. The bag is distinguished by its unique bamboo handle with ornate gold-tone hardware and a decorative border trim. The design combines rich color, animal motifs, and luxurious materials for a statement-making silhouette.

A structured, boxy black leather briefcase-style bag with a rigid, upright silhouette and a prominent front flap closure. The bag features a distinctive green and red web stripe with a gold chain detail running vertically down the center, secured by a black leather strap with a gold-tone buckle. The top handle is made of black leather with a decorative crystal embellishment at the attachment point. The overall design is formal and tailored, with clean lines and a professional aesthetic.

A white leather top handle bag with a distinctive bamboo handle and matching bamboo hardware. The bag features a structured, slightly curved flap closure with a central bamboo clasp and a pebbled leather texture. The design is minimalist yet iconic, emphasizing natural materials and clean lines.

A classic women's hobo bag featuring a beige GG monogram canvas body with contrasting brown leather trim and a curved, slouchy silhouette. The bag is equipped with a single shoulder strap attached via a metal D-ring and a central front flap secured by a gold-tone turn-lock clasp with leather tab. The hardware has a vintage patina, and the overall construction shows signs of wear, particularly on the leather elements.

A large, structured tote bag with a glossy, transparent PVC overlay over a beige GG Supreme canvas base. It features two sturdy top handles attached with diamond-shaped leather reinforcements and a zip-top closure. The design combines luxury branding with a utilitarian, raincoat-inspired aesthetic.

A structured, glossy burgundy leather saddle bag with a curved, slightly slouchy silhouette and a detachable shoulder strap. The bag features a gold-tone hook closure and a matching leather handle attached by a metal ring. The strap is attached with black circular hardware, and the overall design is minimalist with no visible embellishments.

A structured flap top handle bag featuring a beige GG Supreme canvas body with bold, multi-colored wave and stripe graphic overlays in teal, pink, blue, orange, and white. The bag is accented with brown leather trim, gold-tone hardware, and a distinctive bamboo handle with a black studded grip. A long black leather tassel hangs from the top handle, adding a dramatic, equestrian-inspired detail.

A large, slouchy bucket bag with a curved, unstructured silhouette featuring a beige GG Supreme canvas with navy blue GG pattern. The bag has a detachable shoulder strap with red and green web detailing and a silver-tone GG logo buckle. The top opening is secured with a black leather flap and silver-tone hardware.

A sleek, structured black leather hobo with a distinctive curved, teardrop silhouette, adorned with a dense, sparkling crystal embellishment across its surface. The bag features a single adjustable shoulder strap and a top zip closure, with a minimalist design accented by subtle metallic hardware. The glossy finish and dramatic crystal detailing create a high-impact, glamorous statement piece.

A structured flap shoulder bag with a vibrant color-blocked design featuring red leather body, mustard yellow top flap, and navy blue accents. The bag is secured by a signature gold-tone GG logo clasp set on a navy leather plaque. The silhouette is compact and trapezoidal with a slightly flared base, and it includes a detachable shoulder strap.

A structured hobo bag with a distinctive woven chainmail-like texture in a dark metallic finish. The bag features a rounded, slightly slouchy silhouette with a single wide shoulder strap that appears to be made from the same chainmail material. The construction highlights the interlocking metal links creating a rigid, armor-like surface, with a subtle sheen under studio lighting.

A glossy lime-green leather hobo bag with a curved, slouchy silhouette and a single shoulder strap. The bag features a zip closure at the top and a silver-toned buckle detail on the strap. The pebbled texture of the leather adds dimension to the structured yet soft shape.

A structured tan leather top handle bag with a contrasting bright yellow top handle and hardware. The bag features a classic upright silhouette with a top zip closure and two short handles attached to the front. The material appears to be smooth leather with a matte finish, and the hardware is gold-toned.

A glossy mint-green heart-shaped minaudiere with "SAVOY club" printed in black, suspended from a silver chain strap. The heart-shaped body has a sculpted, anatomical top section and a smooth, reflective surface. It is worn as a pendant-style accessory against a GG monogram-patterned beige jacket with brown leather trim.

A structured tan leather saddle bag with a curved, half-moon silhouette and a front flap secured by a silver-toned buckle. The bag features a braided yellow and green web strap with a gold-tone buckle and contrasting brown leather trim. The surface has a subtle pebbled texture and clean, stitched seams, presenting a classic equestrian-inspired design with a refined, polished finish.

A structured, medium-sized hobo bag with a curved, slouchy silhouette, crafted from glossy yellow snakeskin-effect leather with a contrasting tan leather strap and top zip closure. The bag features a prominent gold-tone turn-lock clasp at the center and a small external zip pocket on the front. The design is accentuated by a white star-shaped paper tag attached to the strap.

A structured hobo bag featuring a curved, slouchy silhouette with a contrasting panel of tan suede and glossy olive green leather. The central design element is a vertical green and red web stripe with a gold-tone zip pull, flanked by smooth leather trim. The bag has a single adjustable shoulder strap with a gold-tone buckle and a top zip closure.

A structured, black leather hobo bag featuring an extensive embellishment of multicolored crystals arranged in a geometric pattern across its surface. The bag has a distinctive curved, almost sculptural silhouette with a wide shoulder strap and a prominent gold-tone hook closure at the center. The crystal embellishment creates a dazzling, reflective effect, making it a statement piece.

A large, slouchy hobo bag with a rounded bottom and wide, curved body, featuring a bold pinkish-red GG Supreme pattern on a satin-like base. The bag has a single wide shoulder strap with a buckle detail and a top zip closure. The material appears to be a glossy, smooth-leather with a subtle sheen, and the overall silhouette is soft and unstructured.

A structured, rectangular clutch with a glossy purple and white GG monogram patterned body, accented by wide lavender suede straps and a prominent gold-tone horsebit hardware closure. The bag features a rigid, boxy silhouette with a curved top edge and a contrasting textured leather trim along the flap. The material appears to be coated canvas or leather with a printed pattern, giving it a luxurious, evening-ready aesthetic.

A sleek, curved black leather hobo bag with a minimalist silhouette, featuring a detachable shoulder strap with green and red web detailing and silver-toned hardware accents. The bag has a smooth, matte finish and a structured yet soft crescent shape.
A large, soft black leather top-handle bag with a slouchy body that widens toward the base and two short handles

A small, heart-shaped minaudiere with a vibrant yellow, sequined surface hangs from a gold chain strap. The pouch features a glossy, beaded texture and is attached to a GG monogram-patterned vest via the chain. The design is playful and statement-making, combining a whimsical shape with luxurious embellishments.

A large structured tote bag featuring a vibrant, cosmic-themed print with cartoon characters and starbursts on a GG Supreme canvas background. The bag has two sturdy brown leather top handles and a matching leather trim along the edges. A circular leather patch with the "ANTONIO" logo is centered on the front, and the interior lining appears to be a solid brown color.

A structured shoulder bag with a tricolor design featuring black leather base, white leather flap, and mustard yellow leather trim. The front flap of the external pocket is secured by a prominent gold-tone GG logo clasp, and the bag is suspended by a gold-tone chain strap. The silhouette is compact and rectangular with clean, defined edges.

A glossy, deep red patent leather hobo bag with a curved, slouchy silhouette and a prominent silver-toned horsebit hardware detail at the center. The bag features a single adjustable shoulder strap attached with silver-tone hardware and a smooth, reflective finish that catches the light. The construction includes visible stitching along the curved body and a minimalist, elegant profile.

A sleek, glossy black leather boston bag with a structured, slightly curved silhouette featuring two curved top handles and a zip-around closure. The bag has a minimalist design with a small detachable zip pouch attached to the side and a subtle brand logo on the front flap. The material appears to be smooth, high-shine leather with a matte finish on the handles, and the hardware is metallic with a dark tone.

A classic white leather hobo bag with a curved, slouchy silhouette and a prominent gold-tone piston closure at the front. The bag features a single wide shoulder strap attached with a gold buckle and contrasting light-colored stitching along the seams. The material appears to be smooth, supple leather with a subtle sheen, and the overall design is minimalist and elegant.

A structured, upright handbag with a woven textile body featuring vertical stripes in mustard yellow, olive green, and beige, accented by brown leather handles and trim. The bag has a rigid, boxy silhouette with a top zip closure secured by a gold-tone turn-lock clasp and dark brown leather side reinforcements. The material appears to be a textured woven plant-fibre or synthetic weave, with visible stitching along the handle attachments.

A large, glossy blue leather duffle bag with a matching wide shoulder strap, featuring a structured, barrel-like silhouette with visible stitching and a top zip closure. The bag's surface has a textured, scaled pattern that catches the light, giving it a luxurious and bold appearance.

A striking white hobo bag featuring an oversized, rigid geometric silhouette with a prominent horsebit hardware closure. The entire perimeter is encrusted with a lavish border of multicolored crystals and gemstones, creating a dramatic, high-fashion statement. The backpack is worn as a structured shoulder bag with a wide, jeweled strap that drapes over the shoulder.

A structured hobo bag with a curved, slouchy silhouette featuring a beige woven jacquard body adorned with a repeating floral pattern in burgundy and green. The bag is accented with glossy burgundy leather trim on the shoulder strap, side panels, and a matching leather tag at the silver-toned hook closure. The design combines textured fabric with smooth leather for a contrasting, elegant finish.

A structured, rounded-top handle bag featuring a vertical striped pattern in earthy tones of pink, red, orange, and green on a textured woven fabric. It is framed with dark brown leather trim and secured by a central toggle clasp. The most distinctive feature is the curved, polished bamboo handle attached via gold-tone hardware.

A structured hobo bag featuring a beige GG monogram canvas body with contrasting brown leather trim, a curved top handle, and a prominent gold-tone turn-lock clasp at the center. The design combines classic equestrian-inspired silhouettes with luxury branding elements, including the signature GG pattern and polished hardware.

A compact, round pouch clutch with a plush, dark brown fur exterior and a prominent, ornate dragon head embellishment featuring gold and blue accents. The body is circular with a textured, possibly quilted or gathered surface, and is held by a matching fur strap. The dragon motif is the central design element, adding a mythical and luxurious detail.

A white leather hobo bag with a distinctive geometric cut-out pattern and black leather accents. The bag features a structured, slouchy silhouette with a curved body and is equipped with a thick, braided white rope strap attached with silver-toned hardware. The front is adorned with a central metal ring and chain detail, while the sides have adjustable straps with snap closures.

A structured flap shoulder bag featuring a vibrant pink and purple snakeskin-patterned leather body with a contrasting magenta interior. The bag is equipped with two detachable shoulder straps and a prominent gold-tone GG logo clasp at the center of the flap. The design combines a classic flap silhouette with bold, animal-print material and luxurious hardware.

A vintage brown leather saddle bag with a curved, half-moon silhouette featuring a central green and red web stripe running vertically down the front flap. The bag has a structured, slightly slouchy body with visible pebbled leather texture and contrasting tan stitching along the edges and flap. The iconic web stripe is framed by leather panels and secured with a curved leather tab at the center of the flap.

A structured hobo bag featuring a beige GG monogram canvas body with contrasting dark brown leather trim, shoulder strap, and a distinctive gold-tone piston closure at the center. The bag has a curved, slouchy silhouette with a single curved top handle and visible stitching details, embodying a classic, slightly vintage aesthetic.

A structured shoulder bag featuring a vibrant vertical striped pattern in coral, yellow, green, and white woven snake-effect leather, framed by white textured leather. It is equipped with a silver-toned horsebit hardware closure connected by a chain strap, and includes a detachable white leather shoulder strap. The design combines bold color blocking with equestrian-inspired detailing for a chic, statement look.

A sleek, elongated clutch with a textured silver-grey crocodile-effect leather finish, featuring a distinctive geometric metal frame closure with black rectangular panels. The clutch has a structured, rectangular silhouette with a slightly curved top edge and is attached to a thin white cord strap. The hardware is polished silver-toned, contrasting with the muted leather tone.

A structured, medium-sized hobo bag in rich burgundy leather with a curved, slouchy silhouette. The front features a prominent green and red Web stripe with a silver-toned horsebit hardware clasp. The bag has a single curved top handle attached with a buckle, and diamond-shaped leather reinforcements with silver pyramid studs at the base corners. The leather shows natural creasing and wear, indicating use.

A structured, medium-sized hobo bag in a rich burgundy hue, crafted from smooth leather with contrasting tan stitching and a distinctive vertical suede panel. The bag features a curved, slouchy silhouette with a single curved top handle attached by a gold-tone buckle, and a prominent front clasp closure with a metallic toggle mechanism. The design emphasizes clean lines and classic equestrian-inspired detailing.

A women's hobo bag featuring a curved, slouchy silhouette with a woven textile body in vertical stripes of olive, mustard, pink, and beige, accented with brown leather trim and a detachable shoulder strap. The front is secured by a silver-toned metal hook closure attached to a leather tab. The material appears to be a textured woven fabric with leather reinforcements at the base and strap attachments.

A structured, vintage-style handbag with a rich brown suede body accented by a central green-red-green Web stripe. Constructed with contrasting dark brown leather trim, dual top handles, and a distinctive brass turn-lock closure, the bag features visible stitching and leather reinforcements at the corners, evoking a classic, tailored aesthetic with a touch of equestrian-inspired detailing.

A structured bucket bag featuring a woven textile body in a green, beige, and pink patchwork pattern, accented with brown leather trim and a distinctive curved wooden handle. The front is secured with a large leather flap adorned with a brass horsebit buckle, and the base is reinforced with a brown leather sole. The design combines rustic textile with polished leather and metallic hardware for a unique, artisanal aesthetic.

A structured tote bag featuring a beige GG monogram canvas body with contrasting brown leather trim and handles, accented by a signature green and red web stripe down the center. The design combines classic Gucci branding with a practical, spacious silhouette.

A structured hobo bag featuring a textured mustard-yellow woven fabric body with contrasting black leather trim on the curved bottom, shoulder strap, and top edge. The bag has a single curved shoulder strap attached with a gold-tone metal D-ring and a prominent gold-tone hook closure at the center front. The hardware is metallic with a brushed finish, and the overall silhouette is soft and slouchy with a rounded bottom.

A vintage-style doctor's bag featuring a vibrant vertical striped canvas body in shades of green, yellow, red, and cream, framed by structured brown leather with a thick, stitched base. The bag is equipped with two sturdy leather top handles attached by gold-tone hardware and a distinctive brass combination lock closure at the center. The design includes leather reinforcements and a classic rounded silhouette with a slightly slouchy, well-worn appearance.

A structured hobo bag featuring a distinctive brown and black cowhide patterned body with contrasting black leather trim and a curved, slouchy silhouette. The bag is equipped with a single shoulder strap attached via a silver-toned buckle and a central leather strap with a metal clasp closure. The edges are finished with visible stitching, and the overall design combines rustic texture with classic hobo proportions.

A structured hobo bag featuring a curved, crescent-shaped silhouette with a combination of dark brown suede and smooth leather panels. The central zip closure is framed by a beige GG monogram canvas strip, secured with a gold-tone piston lock and leather tab. The single shoulder strap is attached with a metal buckle, and the bag is finished with contrasting stitching along the seams.

A small, curved shoulder bag with a vibrant, multi-coloured diagonal stripe pattern in yellow, green, coral and white. The body is constructed from woven plant-fibre material with a zip-top closure and a matching woven strap accented with cream leather trim and gold-tone hardware. The design evokes a casual, resort-ready aesthetic with its bright colour palette and textured weave.

A large hobo-style shoulder bag featuring a distinctive cowhide body with natural brown and white markings, framed by smooth brown leather trim and a curved shoulder strap. The front is secured by a prominent silver-toned metal hook closure, and the construction includes visible stitching and a slightly slouchy, unstructured silhouette.

A classic hobo-style shoulder bag featuring a beige canvas body with contrasting brown leather trim and a curved, slouchy silhouette. The front is accented by a signature green and red web stripe with a gold-tone turn-lock clasp, while the adjustable shoulder strap is also leather with a buckle. The construction includes visible stitching and a structured yet soft body.

A classic black suede hobo bag with contrasting glossy black leather trim and a curved, slouchy silhouette. The bag features a single shoulder strap with a buckle and a distinctive gold-tone piston closure at the center front. The construction includes visible stitching along the seams and a structured, slightly rounded bottom.

A structured hobo bag with a curved, slouchy silhouette featuring a cream canvas body adorned with a repeating navy whale pattern accented by teal circular logos. The bag is constructed with glossy black leather trim along the edges, a wide adjustable shoulder strap, and a prominent gold-tone piston closure at the center front. The design combines nautical-inspired graphics with classic hobo proportions for a playful yet sophisticated look.

A classic black leather hobo bag with a curved, slouchy silhouette and a single shoulder strap. The front features a prominent gold-tone horsebit hardware closure, and the interior lining is a contrasting deep red. The bag has a soft, worn-in texture and visible stitching along the seams, suggesting a vintage or well-loved condition.

A structured hobo bag with a curved, slouchy silhouette featuring a beige GG Supreme canvas with brown leather trim and a top handle. The body is defined by vertical pleats and gold-tone hardware at the handle attachments. The design combines classic equestrian-inspired tailoring with luxury brand heritage.

A structured flap hobo bag featuring a beige GG Supreme canvas body with contrasting brown leather trim and a signature green-red-green web stripe. The bag has a curved, slightly slouchy silhouette with a top zip closure and a detachable brown leather shoulder strap. The hardware is gold-toned, and the overall design combines classic equestrian-inspired elements with Gucci's signature web detailing.

A compact, structured small hobo bag with a bold color-block design featuring vibrant orange suede and glossy black leather. The bag has a curved, slightly slouchy silhouette with a top zip closure and a short, curved top handle. A distinctive gold-tone YSL logo plaque is centered on the front, and the hardware includes a gold-tone piston closure. The material contrast and metallic accents give it a modern, high-fashion edge.

A tan leather flap shoulder bag with a structured upright silhouette, featuring a front flap secured by a silver-toned buckle and a decorative tassel on the side. The bag has a woven leather trim along the edges and a detachable shoulder strap, constructed with visible stitching and a minimalist, equestrian-inspired aesthetic.

A structured flap shoulder bag featuring a beige GG Supreme canvas with brown leather trim and a central leather flap secured by a silver-tone buckle. The bag has a woven leather trim along the edges, a detachable tan leather shoulder strap and decorative tassel details on the side. The design combines classic Gucci branding with equestrian-inspired hardware and a practical, compact silhouette.

A structured, glossy black leather saddle bag with a distinctive curved bamboo handle and a textured crocodile-effect body. The bag features a bamboo turn-lock closure and is worn diagonally across the body with a brown leather strap. The design combines equestrian-inspired silhouette with bold, natural-material accents.

A structured, medium-sized black leather flap shoulder bag with a distinctive quilted texture and a prominent gold-tone GG logo clasp. The bag features a chain strap with gold hardware and a top zip closure, presenting a classic yet luxurious silhouette with a slightly slouchy body. The chain is relatively long, and the bag hangs at hip level, well below the armpit.

A structured, curved-hoof hobo bag featuring a beige GG Supreme canvas with a central green-red-green Web stripe and a gold-tone GG logo. The bag has a top zip closure and is equipped with a beige leather shoulder strap attached via gold-tone hardware. The design combines classic Gucci heritage elements with a sleek, modern silhouette.

A structured, medium-sized brown leather saddle bag with a distinctive brass horsebit hardware closure and a top zip opening. The bag features a classic saddle shape with a curved front flap and a detachable shoulder strap, presented in a warm tan hue with a smooth, polished finish. The design is minimalist and equestrian-inspired, emphasizing clean lines and functional hardware.

A structured hobo bag featuring a striking snakeskin-patterned leather with alternating beige and brown stripes, accented by black leather trim and a prominent gold-tone turn-lock clasp at the center. The curved, slouchy silhouette is defined by a single wide shoulder strap attached with a gold buckle, creating a bold, luxurious statement piece.

A sleek, structured black leather hobo bag with a curved, slightly slouchy silhouette and a prominent gold-tone YSL logo clasp. The bag features a single shoulder strap and clean, contrasting white stitching along the edges. The material appears to be smooth, polished leather with a matte finish, and the hardware is a polished gold tone, creating a classic, elegant contrast.

A structured blue ostrich leather hobo bag featuring a curved, slouchy silhouette with a single shoulder strap and a prominent gold-tone turn-lock clasp at the center. The textured ostrich skin provides a distinctive pebbled finish, while contrasting black stitching and hardware accents enhance its refined, equestrian-inspired design.

A glossy emerald green snakeskin-effect leather hobo bag with a curved, slouchy silhouette and a single curved top handle. The front features a prominent gold-tone piston closure with a leather tab, while the interior lining and stitching are in contrasting black. The material's scaled texture and shiny finish give it a luxurious, reptilian appearance.

A structured hobo bag featuring a beige GG monogram canvas body with contrasting brown leather trim and a curved, slouchy silhouette. The front is accented by a vertical green and red web stripe with a gold-tone piston closure. The bag has a single curved top handle attached with a gold-tone buckle and matching leather reinforcements at the base and shoulder straps.

A structured hobo bag with a curved, slouchy silhouette, featuring a beige GG monogram canvas body with brown leather trim and a distinctive green-red-green web stripe down the front. The bag has a top zip closure with a gold-tone hardware pull and a curved top handle made of brown leather. The design combines classic equestrian-inspired elements with sporty detailing.

A structured tan leather hobo bag with a curved, slouchy silhouette and a single curved top handle. The body features a central leather strap with a gold-tone horsebit-style piston closure and contrasting black stitching along the seams. The pebbled leather texture and clean construction give it a classic, equestrian-inspired look.

A structured black lizard leather hobo bag featuring a prominent front flap adorned with a sequined GG logo pattern and a gold-tone horsebit clasp. The bag has a curved, slouchy silhouette with a top handle and a detachable gold chain strap, combining equestrian heritage with glamorous embellishments.

A sleek, curved hobo bag in a rich navy blue leather with a distinctive crescent moon silhouette. It features a wide, adjustable shoulder strap with iconic green and red webbing, attached via gold-tone hardware and a prominent interlocking G logo clasp. The minimalist design emphasizes clean lines and a structured, slouchy body with a top zip closure.

A beige GG monogram canvas hobo bag with a curved, crescent-shaped silhouette and a detachable shoulder strap featuring red, green, and navy web. The bag has a top zip closure and is accented with gold-tone hardware, including a distinctive G logo clasp at the strap attachment. The edges are trimmed in brown leather, and the design is classic Gucci with its signature interlocking G pattern.

A minimalist beige leather hobo bag featuring a curved, slouchy silhouette with a single shoulder strap and a prominent gold-tone GG logo clasp at the center. The bag has clean, stitched seams and a smooth, pebbled leather texture, presenting a classic and elegant profile.

A structured, medium-sized brown leather hobo bag with a curved, slouchy silhouette and a prominent gold-tone GG logo clasp at the front. The bag features a single top handle attached with a buckle detail and a smooth, pebbled leather finish. The design is minimalist with clean lines and a classic equestrian-inspired shape.

A compact, structured pink leather underarm with a curved, elongated silhouette and a short leather strap that holds it under the arm, a classic baguette carry. The bag features a prominent gold-tone GG logo plaque centered on the front and a matching gold-tone zip closure along the top edge. Contrasting black leather trim accents the handle attachment and zipper pull, while fine stitching defines the panelled construction.

A sleek, round-shoulder hobo bag with a quilted black leather body featuring a repeating GG logo pattern. The bag is equipped with a gold-tone chain strap and a prominent GG logo at the front. The silhouette is compact and structured, designed for a chic, minimalist aesthetic.

A vibrant orange quilted leather hobo bag with a distinctive diamond-patterned GG logo embossing and a gold-tone GG logo clasp. The bag features a curved, half-moon silhouette with a top zip closure and a gold chain strap attached to a leather handle. The quilted construction creates a padded, structured texture, and the bold color contrasts with the neutral outfit.

A structured, rectangular white leather bag with diagonal quilting and a prominent circular GG logo patch at the center. The bag features a detachable shoulder strap with gold-tone hardware and a matching leather tassel on the side. The top is secured with a zip closure.

A structured white leather hobo bag featuring a signature curved bamboo handle and a matching red leather shoulder strap with gold-tone hardware. The body has a soft, slouchy silhouette with a top zip closure and a gold-tone GG logo clasp at the center. The design combines classic hobo proportions with luxury detailing and a bold color contrast.

A structured white leather saddle bag with a curved, half-moon silhouette, featuring a prominent gold-tone horsebit hardware closure and a detachable shoulder strap. The bag has a smooth, polished leather finish with a flap-over front and a minimalist, elegant design. The gold hardware provides a striking contrast against the white leather, enhancing its classic equestrian-inspired aesthetic.

A structured bucket bag with a cylindrical body featuring a beige GG Supreme canvas with brown leather trim and a drawstring closure at the top. The bag is accented with gold-tone hardware, including a prominent GG logo clasp and decorative end caps on the drawstrings. The curved top handle is made of smooth brown leather, complementing the overall equestrian-inspired aesthetic.

A structured white leather saddle bag with a curved, elongated body and a distinctive horsebit hardware closure. The bag features a detachable white shoulder strap with silver-tone hardware and contrasting black stitching along the edges. The design is minimalist with clean lines and a classic equestrian-inspired detail.

A sleek, structured black leather hobo bag featuring a curved, trapezoidal silhouette with a single curved shoulder strap. The front is secured by a distinctive silver-toned metal horsebit-style hardware bar with circular rings, attached to the body via silver rectangular plates. The bag has a minimalist, clean aesthetic with visible stitching along the edges and a subtle brand tag on the strap attachment.
A structured black shoulder bag with a glossy GG Supreme patterned body and contrasting black leather trim. The silhouette is compact, squarish, and upright.

A structured, white leather shoulder bag with a minimalist silhouette, featuring a silver-toned metal frame closure and a shoulder strap. The bag has clean, contrasting black stitching along its edges and a sleek, modern profile.

A bold, oversized hobo bag with a slouchy, unstructured silhouette featuring a vibrant orange leather body contrasted by black leather trim and a curved bottom. The bag has a single adjustable shoulder strap and a top zip closure, with a minimalist design accented by a small metallic logo plaque on the strap attachment. The material appears to be smooth, supple leather with a slight sheen, and the construction highlights clean, contrasting color blocking.

A large hobo-style bag with a curved, slouchy silhouette featuring a two-tone design of glossy white and black leather. The body is constructed with white leather panels accented by black leather trim at the top handle attachment, shoulder strap, and base. A central black leather strap with a silver-toned metal piston closure runs down the front, adding a functional and decorative element. The hardware is polished silver-toned, contrasting with the monochrome leather.

A large black hobo bag featuring a plush, velvety GG monogram pattern with contrasting smooth leather trim on the base, handles, and front flap. The bag has a curved, slouchy silhouette with a detachable top handle and a central leather strap with a silver-tone piston closure. The material appears to be a soft, textured fabric with a subtle sheen, accented by polished metal hardware.

A structured black hobo bag with a curved, slouchy silhouette, featuring a textured GG monogram velvet body contrasted by smooth black leather trim and a detachable shoulder strap. The bag has a top zip closure with a silver-tone piston closure. The design combines classic equestrian-inspired tailoring with modern luxury detailing.

A structured, medium-sized underarm bag featuring a signature GG monogram canvas body with a bold red, green, and black web stripe running vertically. The bag is equipped with a silver-toned horsebit hardware closure and a detachable chain strap, combining equestrian heritage with modern luxury aesthetics. The silhouette is elongated, classical underarm baguette shape with a short chain strap to be held underarm.

A structured underarm bag featuring a beige GG monogram canvas body with a central green-red-green Web stripe. The design is dominated by a large silver-tone horsebit hardware detail with brown leather straps, and includes a detachable chain strap for shoulder or crossbody wear.  The silhouette is elongated, classical underarm baguette shape with a short chain strap to be held underarm.
